source: For a variable font, put its weight range in the filename, such as {0}. A filename marked {1} or {2} without a range covers {3}. Nuxt Fonts only declares the {4}default weights{/4}, {5}, even for a variable font file, so other weights render at the nearest one in that range. To use its full range, configure the weights of the font:
